blurb: Come and spend time in our lovely East Coulee Campground where you can enjoy the quiet life of a small Village on the prairies. Situated beside a pond in a valley that intersects the Village. Enjoy the variety of wildlife that migrates through on a regular basis. You can see muskrats, ducks, geese, deer and many others.
